intro: Image-to-video is only as good as its first frame. These prompts generate clean, well-lit first frames of adult subjects that animate well: one subject (or a clearly separated couple), simple background, hands relaxed, face unobstructed or deliberately hidden. Photoreal first frames use Qwen Image 2.1, the recommended uncensored image model on SpicyAPI; anime frames use Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA with an open anime LoRA (the same ones used in SpicyAPI's own examples).
